summary: Functional Brands Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the adjournment of a Special Meeting of Stockholders held May 28, 2026 due to insufficient shares for a quorum. The meeting was reconvened to June 1, 2026 to allow additional proxy solicitation. No changes were made to the proposals. The filing is a routine procedural update regarding a shareholder meeting quorum issue, not a special-situation event.
